rationale: The own-evals half is well supported. New accounts get a free monthly allowance described as enough for a full proof of concept on your own documents, Forge lets you upload a document and see results with no API key, and Marker, Chandra and Surya are free open source you can run yourself. The published-benchmark half is only indirect: community comments reference Marker's own GitHub benchmark and comparison chart against nougat. One commenter questioned the chart's speed figures, but that is about speed rather than accuracy, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: first-party accuracy benchmark documentation, evidence that benchmarks are reproducible (published datasets or scripts), and independent corroboration of accuracy claims.
